rationale: Both reviews independently rediscover the two GT threads (model reading cudagraph_mode should live upstream; per-row seed breaks under full cudagraphs) plus the NPU compilation_config gap, and both are well grounded with specific file:line citations. X edges ahead because its fix for the seed issue literally implements the follow-up refactor gcanlin asked for (move the gating into the runner, drop the model's cudagraph_mode read), and nearly every finding ships a concrete code diff, whereas Y is more conservative/precise but leans on 'consider documenting/adding a test' language more often. X's boldest claim (seed is discarded even at batch=1 due to CUDAGraphWrapper replay semantics) is plausible but unverified and slightly overreaches beyond what the human reviewer stated, which is the main drag on its precision relative to Y's more tightly evidenced claims. Y's unusual process scaffolding (Run report/Scan table/Validated bullets) adds bulk without adding findings, hurting its actionability density.
